Copy-To Cycle (Guard)

Each field copies to the other — the termination guard under test.

Author-Disabled Prefilled Field (Regression)

A server-prefilled field the author disabled outright. Its value fails validation, but a disabled field never submits — it must not hold the gate.

Bubble Placement (Guard)

An error bubble lands in the row's control cell — after a compound wrapper, outside a wrapping label — never inside them.

  • Compound Pair
Mutual Clear Pair (Guard)

Each field clears the other on change. Typing into one must clear only the partner — never the keystroke itself.

Copy To Choice Targets (Guard)

A no-match copy must blank the radio mirror audibly, and a select source must be able to check a checkbox member.

Plan Mirror (required, defaulted)
Interest Mirror
Author Errors Degrade (Guard)

The constraint below is a syntax error and the type below it does not exist. Each must degrade — an inert rule, an untyped field — not abort init with validation off.

Choice Group Comparison (Guard)

A checkbox set reads as its checked values joined with commas, and an expression compares that whole string — two checked boxes match neither value alone.

Site Roles
Deselection Inference

A required field with an authored default can never legitimately be blank, so the engine keeps its deselection off; a default alone leaves it on.

Locked Tier (required, defaulted)
Defaulted Color (optional, defaulted)
Init Settle (Guard)

Gate B is relevant only once Gate A is valid, and the region opens only once Gate B is valid. B is prefilled invalid, so the region must not load open.

Constraint With an Invalid Reference (Guard)

High Bid is prefilled with a value its type rejects, so the constraint on Low Bid has nothing to judge; Ceiling Bid is valid, so Floor Bid's violated constraint flags at load.
